title: Structure and symmetry of the Gross-Pitaevskii ground-state manifold
summary: The structure and degeneracy of ground states of the Gross-Pitaevskii energy functional play a central role in both analysis and computation, yet a precise characterization of the ground-state manifold in the presence of symmetries remains a fundamental challenge. In this paper, we establish sharp theoretical results describing the geometric structure of local minimizers and its implications for optimization algorithms.
